b3_defects.description: image_01: The desk is rotated arbitrarily in the center of the room (island style) rather than aligned with walls or window, creating a visually disjointed layout.

image_03: There appears to be clipping between the laptop and monitor on the right side of the desk view. The chair back in image 1 seems slightly inside the room geometry/door frame area or simply positioned awkwardly relative to the rug.

worst_object.reason: The position is floating (not touching walls) and rotated arbitrarily, conflicting with standard ergonomic layouts which usually place desks against a wall.

comment: スケーリングと配置は概ね適切ですが、照明が白飛び気味で天井の質感が見切られているため物理的妥当性は中程度です。机を島の如く中央に置くレイアウトは無駄な空間を生み、没入感を損なっています。
